summary: Planban 1.1.7 stops the Board page reloading in a loop, shows which cards need you, warns agents about out-of-date cards, shortens Copy Reference, and removes unused dependencies with a clean security audit.
updatePrompt: Update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Verify version 1.1.7, the installed plugin, and MCP tools; open an existing Board and confirm it remains readable and writable. This release changes dependencies, so a clean dependency install is expected. Reinstall the plugin after refreshing the marketplace so cached skills, hook scripts, and MCP instructions are updated, then start a new session.
changelogSummary: A steady Board page, Needs you on cards, out-of-date warnings for agents, a shorter Copy Reference, and a smaller install.
